magical.en: The snowy forest looked magical under the early morning light.
magical.zh: 覆雪森林在清晨光線下看起來十分夢幻。

magician.en: The magician surprised the audience with a clever card trick.
magician.zh: 魔術師用巧妙的紙牌魔術讓觀眾驚喜。

magnet.en: A strong magnet can attract certain metals from a short distance.
magnet.zh: 強力磁鐵可以從短距離吸引某些金屬。

magnetic.en: The experiment demonstrated how a magnetic field affects a compass needle.
magnetic.zh: 實驗示範磁場如何影響指南針指針。

magnificent.en: We saw a magnificent view of the mountains from the train.
magnificent.zh: 我們從火車上看到了壯麗的山景。

magnify.en: This microscope can magnify tiny cells for closer observation.
magnify.zh: 這台顯微鏡可以放大微小細胞，方便仔細觀察。

maid.en: The novel mentions a maid who works in a large country house.
maid.zh: 小說提到一位在大型鄉間宅邸工作的女僕。

maiden.en: The old tale follows a brave maiden through a mysterious forest.
maiden.zh: 這則古老故事描述一位勇敢少女穿越神祕森林。

mail.en: The school sent the registration form by mail last week.
mail.zh: 學校上週以郵件寄出了報名表。

mainland.en: A ferry connects the small island to the mainland every morning.
mainland.zh: 渡輪每天早上連接這座小島與大陸。

mainstream.en: The idea moved from a small community into mainstream discussion.
mainstream.zh: 這個想法從小眾社群進入主流討論。

maintenance.en: Regular maintenance keeps the school computers working reliably.
maintenance.zh: 定期維護能讓學校電腦穩定運作。

majestic.en: The majestic mountain rose above the clouds in the distance.
majestic.zh: 雄偉的山峰在遠方高出雲層。

majesty.en: Visitors admired the majesty of the ancient temple at sunrise.
majesty.zh: 遊客在日出時欣賞古寺的宏偉氣勢。

makeup.en: The theater club prepared stage makeup before the evening performance.
makeup.zh: 戲劇社在晚間演出前準備舞台妝。

male.en: The study compared male and female birds during the nesting season.
male.zh: 這項研究比較築巢季節中的雄鳥與雌鳥。

mall.en: We met at the mall before taking the bus home.
mall.zh: 我們搭公車回家前在購物中心碰面。

mammal.en: A whale is a mammal even though it lives in water.
mammal.zh: 鯨魚雖然生活在水中，仍然是哺乳動物。

man.en: The man at the information desk showed us the correct platform.
man.zh: 服務台的那名男子告訴我們正確月台。

management.en: Good time management helps students balance study and rest.
management.zh: 良好的時間管理能幫助學生平衡讀書與休息。

mandate.en: The new policy gives schools a mandate to reduce unnecessary waste.
mandate.zh: 新政策授權學校減少不必要的浪費。

mango.en: She cut a ripe mango into pieces for the fruit salad.
mango.zh: 她把熟芒果切成小塊做水果沙拉。

manifest.en: Stress can manifest in different ways during a busy exam week.
manifest.zh: 壓力在繁忙考試週可能以不同方式表現出來。

mankind.en: The documentary asks how technology may shape the future of mankind.
mankind.zh: 這部紀錄片探討科技可能如何塑造人類的未來。

mansion.en: The historic mansion now serves as a museum for local visitors.
mansion.zh: 這座歷史宅邸如今作為地方博物館使用。

manual.en: The instruction manual explains how to assemble the desk safely.
manual.zh: 說明手冊解釋如何安全組裝這張書桌。

manufacturer.en: The manufacturer recalled the product after discovering a design problem.
manufacturer.zh: 製造商發現設計問題後召回了產品。

manuscript.en: The library preserves a handwritten manuscript from the nineteenth century.
manuscript.zh: 圖書館保存了一份十九世紀的手寫稿。

maple.en: A red maple stood beside the entrance to the park.
maple.zh: 一棵紅楓樹立在公園入口旁。

mar.en: Heavy pollution can mar the beauty of a natural landscape.
mar.zh: 嚴重污染可能破壞自然景觀的美感。

marathon.en: She trained for months before completing her first marathon.
marathon.zh: 她訓練了好幾個月，才完成第一次馬拉松。

marble.en: The museum floor was made from smooth white marble.
marble.zh: 博物館地板由光滑的白色大理石鋪成。

march.en: Students watched the band march across the field during the ceremony.
march.zh: 學生在典禮中看著樂隊行進穿過操場。

margin.en: Write your notes in the margin beside the paragraph.
margin.zh: 把筆記寫在段落旁的頁邊空白處。

marine.en: Marine scientists recorded changes in water temperature near the reef.
marine.zh: 海洋科學家記錄了珊瑚礁附近水溫的變化。

marker.en: Use a black marker to label each box clearly.
marker.zh: 用黑色麥克筆清楚標示每個箱子。

marriage.en: The novel follows a family through many years of marriage.
marriage.zh: 這本小說描寫一個家庭多年的婚姻生活。

married.en: The biography explains that the writer married young and moved abroad.
married.zh: 傳記說明這位作家年輕時結婚並搬到國外。

martial.en: The museum displayed traditional martial equipment from several historical periods.
martial.zh: 博物館展示了不同歷史時期的傳統武術裝備。

marvel.en: Visitors often marvel at the detailed carvings inside the old temple.
marvel.zh: 遊客常對古寺內精細的雕刻感到驚嘆。

marvelous.en: The concert ended with a marvelous performance by the school orchestra.
marvelous.zh: 音樂會以校管弦樂團精彩的演出作結。

masculine.en: The article examines how language can express masculine and feminine styles.
masculine.zh: 文章探討語言如何表達陽剛與陰柔風格。

mask.en: The actor wore a colorful mask during the traditional dance.
mask.zh: 演員在傳統舞蹈中戴著彩色面具。

massage.en: A gentle shoulder massage helped her relax after a long day.
massage.zh: 輕柔的肩部按摩讓她在漫長一天後放鬆下來。

massive.en: The storm caused massive delays across the regional train network.
massive.zh: 暴風雨造成區域鐵路系統大規模延誤。

master.en: It takes patience and practice to master a new language skill.
master.zh: 要熟練一項新的語言技能需要耐心與練習。

masterpiece.en: Many critics consider the painting a masterpiece of modern art.
masterpiece.zh: 許多評論家認為這幅畫是現代藝術傑作。

mastery.en: Regular practice gradually leads to greater mastery of difficult concepts.
mastery.zh: 規律練習會逐漸提升對困難概念的掌握。

mat.en: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before entering the room.
mat.zh: 進房間前請在地墊上擦一擦鞋子。

match.en: This blue shirt does not match the green jacket very well.
match.zh: 這件藍色上衣和綠色外套不太搭。
